summary: Full end-to-end frontend testing of Treesh M.A.D. What's New (songcoder.html + treesh-main.html loader). All 9 scenarios in the review request pass. Setup (reset+signin+tab) shows wn-file-missing notice, 7 popup cards all Code, 8 slides read-only, access table + slides-select present. Tab bar no overlap at 1400/1920/390. Take-over flow: wn-popup-take-btn-player opens drawer prefilled 'Music Player'; em-dash '—' in title triggers wn-fix-dashes-btn (clicking it strips the dash — note: replacement is ', ' not ' - ', product choice); item 0 edit/down/dup/remove-1/add-item work; wn-item-icon-btn-0 opens wn-icon-picker, search 'rocket' lands wn-icon-option-rocket; Phone/Desktop toggle updates preview; wn-popup-bump-toggle flips; wn-apply-btn saves, card access becomes 'Managed', meta shows 'v7 → re-shows', publish bar visible with count 1. New popup: wn-popup-page-select offers ['studios','blog','__custom']; empty-title submit shows error toast and drawer stays open; valid create produces wn-popup-card-studios with wn-popup-delete-btn-studios. Access: setting access-select-player=managed enables lock/hide/reset; wn-popup-lock-btn-player → 'Locked' with edit/hide/reset disabled; unlock → Managed; hide → 'Hidden' with .off dim class; select=code resets. Custom studios access options exclude 'code' (['managed','locked','hidden']). Slides: wn-slide-mode-managed makes slides editable (8 up-btns); wn-new-slide-btn opens wn-slide-drawer; invalid url (action url: + 'notvalid') toast 'Links need to start with https://'; invalid art 'foo' toast 'Artwork must be a built-in art key or an https link.'; valid save w/ action page:library + bronze-blitz_main art inserts 'test-slide' first in wn-slides-list; wn-slide-mode-locked disables all slide buttons. Master wn-auto-popups-toggle flips text. Publish PR: wn-publish-btn opens publish-success-modal 'Pull request opened #1 · Update What's New popups and slides'. Verified via /api/mockgh/state (PR #1 branch songcoder/whatsnew-mv0dp8yk, title correct) and /api/github/repo/contents/content/whatsnew.json?ref=<branch>: popups.player.mode='managed', v=8 (7+1 bump), title='Player test popup', 7 items, zero underscore-keys; slides.mode='managed' with list starting with 'test-slide'; settings.autoPopups=true. Live mode (set via localStorage treesh_songcoder_cfg_v2 mode:'live') + another change (artists→hidden) + publish → modal 'What's New is live'; after reload wn-file-missing hidden and wn-publish-bar hidden. Site check: wn-site-check-btn opens modal with 'Open M.A.D. at treesh.app/tools/mad' text (expected in preview). Draft autosave: change persists after reload with wn-draft-notice visible and publish-bar restored; wn-discard-btn → wn-discard-confirm-modal (buttons confirm-cancel-btn/confirm-ok-btn) → bar hidden and value reverts. Loader on /treesh-main.html (?wn-preview=player, after localStorage treesh_profile): __treeshWN.loader=2; WHATS_NEW.player.title='Player test popup' v=99; WHATS_NEW.artists===undefined (hidden); WHATS_NEW.studios.title='Studios news' (locked still applies); WNU length=1 with only 'test-slide' (disabled + future slides excluded); test-slide kicker 'New <i>' is HTML-escaped ('<i>'); Home carousel renders [data-testid=whats-new-update-test-slide] with CTA data-val='page:library'; clicking CTA navigates to #/library with no console errors; ?wn-preview=player auto-opens the Player test popup after ~2s. Regression: Artists view still shows artists-fix-banners-notice and 12 artist-edit-btn (drawer opens). No console errors in songcoder (only expected CORS warnings fetching treesh.app).

issues: wn-fix-dashes-btn replaces em-dash with ', ' (comma+space) rather than a ' - ' hyphen; functionally removes dash but may not be the most natural replacement — minor UX nit, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: wnPublish correctly strips internal _* keys from popups and slides before writing content/whatsnew.json (verified via base64-decoded PR body — zero underscore-prefixed keys in player or slide objects).

Access matrix enforcement: lock state disables edit/hide/reset; custom popups omit the 'code' option in both access-select and WN_ACCESS filter; verified at wn-access-select-studios (['managed','locked','hidden']).

Em-dash lint replacement in wnLint/wn-fix-dashes-btn: current implementation replaces '—' with ', ' which strips the dash but changes semantic punctuation. Consider using ' - ' (hyphen with spaces) for a more faithful typographic fix.

wn_loader.js (lines 20848-20885 of treesh-main.html, and /app/memory/wn_loader.js identical): correctly honors mode=code/hidden (deletes entry), locked (keeps built-in), managed (overrides with sanitized clone). inWindow() filters future/past slides. HTML-escapes kicker/title/desc via esc() — verified by setting kicker 'bold' and reading WNU[0].k === 'New <i>'. Preview URL ?wn-preview= opens the popup after 1800ms setTimeout.

First-visit UX note: on treesh-main.html the main app's own auto-popup opens the Home popup (library) ~immediately on load; the loader's ?wn-preview=player then supersedes it via closeModal() + wnOpen() at ~1800ms. Works as designed but means the user briefly sees the Home popup before the preview target.
test_credentials: M.A.D. passcode: TreeshMAD-test-2026. Mock reset: POST /api/mockgh/reset (same-origin).

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Minor UX nit: em-dash fix produces ', ' comma; consider a hyphen replacement.
